tier_definition: ANCHORED = a headline metric computed on a real, publicly available, externally labeled corpus via a fixed, documented protocol. It is NOT synthetic, NOT hand-set, and NOT self-generated by the system under test. The opposite tier is EXTRAPOLATED (synthetic or projected).
claim: Interpretable verbal-science verifiability features discriminate deceptive from truthful text on a real labeled corpus, above a pre-registered AUC kill threshold, with honest out-of-fold calibration.

frozen_reference.note: Byte-frozen pre-registration. Changing the empirical result requires re-running the protocol AND updating this pin in the same reviewed commit — never edit one without the other.

data_source.name: Ott et al. (2011/2013) Deceptive Opinion Spam Corpus
data_source.composition: 800 deceptive (Amazon MTurk) / 800 truthful (TripAdvisor/Expedia/…), balanced 50/50 by sentiment
data_source.license_notes: Ott et al.; redistribute via loader + checksum, not raw text
data_source.committed_note: Corpus is licensed and fetched by the loader into a gitignored path; never committed.

protocol.description: Stratified 5-fold cross-validation (Ott's own protocol), standardized logistic regression isotonic-calibrated via nested CV so reported probabilities are honest out-of-fold; metrics on pooled out-of-fold predictions.
protocol.grouping_strategy: hotel_index from canonical 20x20 block order (hotel-independent groups)

metric_definitions.roc_auc: ROC AUC on pooled out-of-fold predictions
metric_definitions.auc_ci95: 2000x bootstrap 95% confidence interval on ROC AUC
metric_definitions.ece: Expected Calibration Error on out-of-fold isotonic-calibrated probabilities

kill_gate.rule: verdict = PASS iff headline roc_auc >= threshold_auc; otherwise the claim is falsified and Phase 1 stays blocked. The stored verdict is re-derived by the integrity gate, never trusted.

headline.role: the interpretable verifiability-feature model — the claim under test

baseline.role: null control — must be statistically indistinguishable from chance; its 95% CI must bracket 0.5

ceiling.role: leakage ceiling — a surface-lexical shortcut with high in-domain AUC that must NOT be read as capability
ceiling.contamination_reason: TF-IDF surface shortcut; in-domain AUC ~0.955 collapses to ~0.51 (chance) cross-corpus per research/cogveritas/leakage_audit.py
